_note: Relic catalog — Common (25) + Uncommon (18), the v0.4 half of §7.8's build order. Rare and Legendary are v0.5; `tier`, `discovery` and the four Tier-3 rows are v0.6 (§8.6.1). Rows come from docs/design/catalogs/relics.md; `hook` maps each onto §7.7's named-hook vocabulary, so a new relic is data as long as its hook already exists. The hand is discarded whole each turn (§3.4), so "max hand size +1" and "draw +1" are the same effect here and the descriptions say the one the player sees. Every row is live since v0.7.5: the four that waited on an activated action were rewritten as passives (§7.3), which keeps combat free of relic buttons. A row whose system does not exist would carry `pending`, and the UI would show it rather than sell a no-op.
